_readme: The registered insurer population, transcribed from the IRDAI Annual Report
2024-25 annexures. This is the AUTHORITY for which insurers are current and
which segment each belongs to.
Why it has to be curated: nothing in the handbook data distinguishes a current
insurer from one that has wound up or merged. Both were checked and both fail.
The footnote markers ($ * ^^ #) that mark exits in the handbook's own tables are
absent from the frame the app reads, and 'last filed year' is not a proxy either
- Exide Life and Sahara India Life both still show 2024-25, years after ceasing
to write business, because the handbook keeps carrying them.
Insurers NOT listed here are not errors and must not be deleted. They are
registered insurers that discontinued operations or merged, and their historical
filings are real. They are marked inactive so that current counts, market shares
and peer cohorts exclude them, while history still resolves.
Sources, all from IRDAI Annual Report 2024-25:
Annexure 3 (p.162) - Motor Third Party market share: the definitive list of 25
general insurers.
Annexure 1 (p.158) - LIST OF REGISTERED INSURERS/REINSURERS OPERATING IN INDIA
as on 31 March 2025: the registration list. Reinsurers page transcribed.
Annexure 6 (p.171) - micro-insurance products by life insurers: 24 life
insurers, and the second confirmation of CreditAccess Life.
Annexure 7 (p.172) - products and riders: life, general, specialised (public
sector) and standalone health, split public/private.
Names are as printed, including the report's own typos ('Future Generalli',
'CreditAccess Life Insurance Ltd..'), because matching is done on normalised
tokens rather than exact strings and the printed form is the citable one.
source: IRDAI Annual Report 2024-25, Annexure 1 (registration list, p.157-158); Annexures 3, 6, 7 for activity

_pending: RESOLVED: life 26 and SAHI 8 both reconcile against Annexure 1 (p.157). The earlier
shortfall came from using Annexures 3/6/7, which are ACTIVITY tables - Sahara (life
business transferred) and Reliance Health (barred from new policies) are registered
but file no products, so they are absent there and present here.
RESOLVED: ITI Reinsurance is Investment Trust of India, licence cancelled - a
different entity from Valueattics. The suspected rename was wrong and was not acted on.
OPEN - segment totals sum to 75 (26 life + 25 non-life + 2 specialised + 8 SAHI +
2 reinsurers + 12 FRB/Lloyd's) against the 74 stated. Likely a counting convention
around Lloyd's India or the specialised pair; not chased.
OPEN - we hold no data at all for Valueattics Reinsurance (newly registered) or for
several FRBs (Allianz Global, Hannover, Munich Re, Swiss Re, Markel, Volante).

_note: Registered per Annexure 1, so they COUNT toward the segment totals, but are
not writing new business. Cohorts, market shares and 'current' views should
exclude them; history must still resolve.
registered_but_not_writing.sahara_india_life_insurance_ltd: Life business transferred to SBI Life by IRDAI order dated 02.06.2023 (Annexure 1 footnote)
registered_but_not_writing.reliance_health_insurance_ltd: Directed to stop selling new policies - IRDA/F&A/ORD/SOLP/200/11/2019 dated 06.11.2019 (Annexure 1 footnote $)
registered_but_not_writing.iti_reinsurance_ltd: ITI = Investment Trust of India. Absent from Annexure 1; licence reported cancelled by IRDAI. NOT the same entity as Valueattics Reinsurance.
